reports.title: AKAMAI REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

lines: Given our CIS momentum, track record of execution and continued strong pipeline, we expect Akamai's overall revenue growth to accelerate to 17% to 22% year-over-year when adjusted for foreign exchange* in 2027.
We expect further acceleration in 2028 with total revenue projected to exceed $7.0 billion,” Leighton added.
